text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is recommending the removal of an on-street accessible loading zone, operating from 10:00 a.m. to 8:00 p.m., daily, on the east side of Gilbert Avenue, between a point 74.5 metres south of Rogers Road and a point 11 metres further south.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Rescinded the existing on-street accessible loading zone, operating from 10:00 a.m. to 8:00 p.m. daily, on the east side of Gilbert Avenue, between a point 74.5 metres south of Rogers Road and a point 11 metres further south.
